role: bounded provider and operation health evidence producer

obligations.action: Support provider_outage advice only with current correlated health evidence; a timeout alone remains a candidate signal.
obligations.scope: Use Registry operation policy keys and preserve gateway versus external dependency class.
obligations.timing: Enforce probe policy windows and report bounded current-at-assessment validity.
obligations.redaction: Return state, class, policy version, and opaque reference only; exclude probe credentials, requests, responses, and sampled rows.
obligations.unknown_fallback: Uncorrelated, stale, or contradictory observations cannot select outage and must remain unknown.
